title: Caller-controlled name escapes the intended storage boundary

rootCause.statement: The handler will persist a resource under a location built from a caller-supplied name, without confirming the resolved location stays inside the intended sandbox, so the caller can escape it.
rootCause.recommendedFix: Stop trusting the caller-supplied name; resolve it against a fixed location and reject anything that escapes the intended sandbox.

issue.title: Caller-controlled name escapes the intended storage boundary
issue.body: Summary: A request parameter supplies a name that is used to persist a resource without confirming the resolved location stays inside the intended sandbox, letting the caller escape it and overwrite unrelated resources. Data Flow (source -> sink): request parameter -> resource persistence with no containment check.
